remarks: Welcome to this fantastic 3 Bed 2 Bath home nestled on a large private lot in Wilson. Inside, the home offers a warm country feel with numerous modern updates throughout, including new engineered hardwood floors (2022), windows and doors (2023), and a beautifully updated full bath with step-in shower (2023). The bright yet cozy living room features a gas fireplace, while the main level offers a primary bedroom and full bath for convenient 1 level living. 2 additional bedrooms located upstairs. The spacious full basement features 8-foot ceilings, an additional finished room and bathroom plus a walkout for easy access and egress. Other updates include a new tear-off roof (2019) with gutters, furnace (2019), and hot water tank (2018).A wonderful opportunity to enjoy privacy, character, and modern updates in the heart of Wilson.
